recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-36195 unless the work group separately decides to reintroduce an operation backbone in a future Device or DeviceAssociation issue.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 OO change request for FHIR-core Device to replace Device.operationalStatus with an operation/operationalState backbone containing status, statusReason, operator, mode, cycle, and duration details for device use.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites commit 2c8d41bdffb2e2cbc27ec8bfb76ee0f9edf2d0d1 as the build application. Nearby commits 0e4e912dedef663db1fc73bcee4b3ab79586023e and d76dc5b48270664a83bc7b51d07bfc4b7f78e6ed changed Device.operationalStatus to Device.operationalState and added the requested children; the Jira-linked commit refined the operator short text. FHIR-37545 later completed the family rename to Device.operation.
additional_context: FHIR-37545 renamed Device.operationalState to Device.operation and aligned operation value set names. FHIR-38904 later removed the Device operation/operationStatus backbone while introducing DeviceAssociation. FHIR-48924 later removed the remaining Device.mode, Device.cycle, and Device.duration elements in favor of Device operation extensions. Current Device and DeviceAssociation are active resources, but parsed current source contains no active Device.operation, Device.operationalState, Device.operationalStatus, or DeviceAssociation.operation elements.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-applying the FHIR-36195 R5 structure would conflict with later published R5/R6 Device decisions, and the current built source is already consistent with those later decisions.
